name: i-ran-pilot
style: Realistic cinematic photography, anamorphic 35mm music-video look, moody but readable exposure: dark emerald and teal shadows, a warm orange firelight key on faces, thin green lasers in humid haze, rim light, sweat glistening, natural skin detail, correct human anatomy and natural proportions, subtle film grain, physically coherent motion.

rafa.name: Rafa
rafa.identity: Keep exactly his face, bone structure, dark eyes, thick curly black hair, thin moustache and goatee, diamond stud earrings, warm olive-tan skin (the same tone on face, arms and legs) and lean athletic build.
rafa.look: Earthy jungle-festival utility set: an unbuttoned short-sleeve camp shirt worn open over his bare chest with a black tactical nylon chest harness with grey buckles strapped over his bare torso, and matching relaxed knee-length cargo shorts with plain flat flap side pockets, both cut from the same washed olive-khaki cotton ripstop fabric; a faded grey paisley bandana knotted loosely around his neck; his thin gold chain with a small cross pendant plus a short cord necklace of dark wooden beads; stacked chunky silver chain bracelets on both wrists; and on his feet only, scuffed tan suede lace-up boots with grey socks.

lune.name: Lune
lune.identity: Keep exactly her face, features, full lips, brown eyes, freckles and long wavy chestnut-brown hair; a slim confident woman in her mid twenties with sun-warm skin.
lune.look: Earthy-futurist jungle-festival outfit: a strappy brushed-silver metallic halter harness bikini top; low-slung distressed washed-olive denim micro shorts with frayed hems; a thin beaded waist chain; stacked silver chain bracelets and a twisted barbed-wire-style silver cuff climbing her left forearm; a wide metallic silver fabric headwrap tied across her forehead with a few small yellow flowers tucked into her hair; small silver hoops; and on her feet only, short scuffed tan suede lace-up ankle boots.

canopy_floor.prompt: a packed night-time jungle rave rendered as soft out-of-focus bokeh behind the subject: blurred silhouetted dancers, glowing teal stage lights, green laser haze and warm bulb strings through palm fronds.

lagoon_edge.prompt: the dark edge of a jungle lagoon, softly defocused, orange fire reflections rippling on black water, big leaves in the near foreground, pale moonlit mist far behind.

jungle_trail.prompt: a moonlit jungle trail between giant leaves and hanging vines, silver-blue moonlight shafts through mist, softly defocused.

rope_bridge.prompt: a swaying wooden rope bridge over dark jungle lined with small torches, the glowing futuristic festival city and a huge full moon far behind, softly defocused.

cliff_top.prompt: a rocky jungle clifftop high above a moonlit lagoon, a huge full moon in drifting mist, the glowing festival city far off, softly defocused.

lagoon_underwater.prompt: deep teal water under the lagoon surface, shafts of moonlight, rising silver bubbles, floating leaves.

cliff_moon.prompt: a dark jungle cliff edge in silhouette on the right, an enormous warm amber full moon filling the night sky behind, thin mist below.

lagoon_moon.prompt: calm dark lagoon water at night, an enormous warm amber full moon low on the horizon behind, its golden reflection rippling on the water, dark jungle silhouettes at the edges.

shots.summary: The rave at its peak, seen through palm fronds.
shots.still: A sea of silhouetted dancers with raised hands under fanning green lasers, palm fronds framing the top of the frame.
shots.motion: Hands pump to the beat; lasers sweep left to right.
shots.camera: Slow push forward through the fronds.

shots.summary: Present day: Lune is lost in the song in the middle of the crowd.
shots.framing: Eye-level medium close-up from the chest up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, other ravers soft on both sides. Tight framing: the face fills the upper third of the frame, cropped at the chest.
shots.still: Lune sings along with her eyes closed, face lifted, a warm orange firelight key on her face and teal laser spill on her shoulder.
shots.motion: She sways, mouths the words, and slowly turns her head to her left.
shots.camera: Fast handheld 180-degree orbit around her, ravers sliding past in the foreground.

shots.summary: Flashback: the same head turn, now in the moonlit jungle, laughing.
shots.framing: Eye-level medium close-up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Flashback grade: cooler moonlit blue-teal, dreamy haze, soft halation. Tight framing: the face fills the upper third of the frame, cropped at the chest.
shots.still: Lune, hair swinging, turns her head to her left and breaks into a laugh, looking back over her shoulder at someone chasing her.
shots.motion: She completes the turn, laughs, and starts to run out of frame left.

shots.summary: Flashback: Rafa chases after her, grinning.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 50mm lens, moonlit blue-teal flashback grade, motion blur in the background.
shots.still: Rafa runs toward camera through big leaves, grinning, his bandana and open shirt flying.
shots.motion: He runs toward camera and pushes a large leaf aside that sweeps across the lens.
shots.camera: Low fast backward tracking shot, leaves whipping past the lens.

shots.summary: Present day: a leaf-shaped shadow wipes off Lune's face; she opens her eyes, searching.
shots.framing: Close-up of her face and shoulders, 100mm lens, background melted into bokeh.
shots.still: Lune opens her eyes, the smile gone, and searches the crowd, warm fire rim light on her hair.
shots.motion: Her eyes flick left and right; she lowers her chin.

shots.summary: Flashback: running hand in hand across the torch-lit rope bridge.
shots.framing: Medium two-shot from behind, 35mm lens, moonlit blue-teal flashback grade with warm torch points.
shots.still: Lune pulls Rafa by the hand across a swaying rope bridge toward the glowing festival city, both laughing.
shots.motion: They run away from camera; she looks back at him.
shots.camera: Drone-like sweep from low behind them rising up over the bridge ropes.

shots.summary: Flashback: Rafa, breathless, looks at her with wonder.
shots.framing: Medium close-up, 85mm lens, flashback grade, torch bokeh. Tight framing: the face fills the upper third of the frame, cropped at the chest.
shots.still: Rafa catches his breath on the bridge, hair damp, looking at her just off camera with a soft smile.
shots.motion: He exhales, laughs, and reaches his hand toward the camera.

shots.summary: Present day: an outstretched hand from the crowd; Lune reaches back into nothing.
shots.framing: Medium close-up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Tight framing: the face fills the upper third of the frame, cropped at the chest.
shots.still: Lune reaches her hand out into the crowd, fingers open, eyes wet, green laser light across her.
shots.motion: Her hand closes on empty air and slowly falls.
shots.camera: Push-in with a rack focus from her reaching hand to her face.

shots.summary: Flashback: running hand in hand toward the cliff edge above the moonlit lagoon.
shots.framing: Medium-wide shot from behind, 24mm lens, deep shadows, moonlit amber backlight.
shots.still: Silhouettes of Lune and Rafa running hand in hand from behind through a curtain of hanging jungle roots and vines toward a glowing cliff edge, moonlight blazing through the gaps.
shots.motion: They run flat out toward the edge and push off together.
shots.camera: Fast low handheld tracking shot right behind their heels, the roots whipping past the lens.

shots.summary: Flashback, slow motion: they leap off the cliff hand in hand across a giant full moon.
shots.framing: Wide side-profile shot, 135mm telephoto compression: a giant amber full moon fills most of the frame behind the cliff edge on the right.
shots.still: Lune and Rafa, pure black silhouettes in side profile, leap off the jungle cliff edge hand in hand, legs mid-stride, arms outstretched, crossing the face of the enormous glowing moon.
shots.motion: In graceful slow motion they sail across the moon and begin to arc downward.
shots.camera: Locked-off telephoto with a slow drift to follow the arc.

shots.summary: Flashback: they plunge into the lagoon in an explosion of bubbles.
shots.framing: Underwater medium shot, 24mm lens, moonlight rays from the surface, teal water.
shots.still: Underwater, Lune and Rafa plunge into the dark lagoon side by side in an explosion of churning white bubbles, moonlight shafts from the surface above.
shots.motion: In slow motion the bubbles burst around them, then they kick upward toward the light.
shots.camera: Underwater, drifting upward with them through the bubbles.

shots.summary: Present day: Lune surfaces from the memory at the same lagoon edge, alone.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field.
shots.still: Lune stops at the dark lagoon edge, fire reflections behind her on the water, catching her breath.
shots.motion: She slows, turns around, and looks back toward the party.

shots.summary: Rafa steps out from the leaves, real and present.
shots.framing: Medium shot from the waist up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field.
shots.still: Rafa pushes giant leaves aside and steps onto the lagoon edge, orange glow on his face.
shots.motion: He steps forward and stops, eyes locked on her.
shots.camera: Low-angle push-in as he steps through, leaves sweeping across the lens.

shots.framing: Intimate close two-shot, 85mm lens, background melted into bokeh.
shots.still: Lune rests her hand on Rafa's chest as they sway together, foreheads nearly touching, teal and orange light mixing on their faces.
shots.motion: They sway to the beat; she laughs softly.
shots.camera: Handheld 360-degree orbit around the couple, firelight flaring through.

shots.summary: They surface and kiss waist-deep in the lagoon before the giant moon.
shots.framing: Medium two-shot at water level, 135mm telephoto, the giant amber full moon filling the background, its reflection rippling on the water.
shots.still: Lune and Rafa, wet hair slicked back, hold each other waist-deep in the dark water and kiss, silhouetted against the enormous glowing moon.
shots.motion: Slow motion: they pull close and kiss, water dripping, ripples spreading.
shots.camera: Slow push-in at water level, a gentle rack focus onto their faces.

sheet.front: Character reference panel: one full-body front view, head to toe with both feet fully visible and space above the head, standing straight and relaxed, arms at the sides, facing the camera. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.back: Character reference panel: one full-body BACK view. The person faces directly away from the camera: we see the back of the head, the hair from behind, the shoulder blades, the back of the outfit, the backs of the legs and the heels. The face is not visible at all. Head to toe with both feet fully visible, arms relaxed at the sides. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.side: Character reference panel: one full-body SIDE profile view. The person is turned a strict 90 degrees to the right: only the right side of the body and one eye are visible, nose pointing to the right edge of the frame, like a passport profile. Head to toe with both feet fully visible, arms relaxed at the sides. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.anchor: Three-quarter-length fashion reference photo from the top of the head to mid-thigh, standing straight facing the camera, arms relaxed, the whole outfit clearly visible. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.
sheet.closeup: Character reference panel: an extreme close-up portrait of the face and shoulders only. The head fills the upper two thirds of the frame; the crop ends at the upper chest. Facing the camera directly, neutral expression. Do not show the waist, legs or feet. Seamless flat light grey studio background, soft even diffused light, photoreal, natural skin texture with a light sheen of sweat, sharp focus, no text, no labels, no other people.

keyframe_rules: Use the reference images only for each person's identity and wardrobe: do not copy their pose, framing, lighting or grey background. Relight them with the scene: warm firelight on the face, teal and green laser spill on skin, sweat glistening. Natural candid mid-action body language, never posing for the camera.
extras: Background ravers are varied strangers in their own clothes (camo tanks, crop tops, fishnet, hoodies, tech visor goggles, glow bracelets); none of them wears the lead characters' outfits.
soundscape: Muffled heavy festival bass, crowd cheering, humid jungle night ambience, no dialogue.
variation_hints: Alternate take: a more dynamic camera, a faster orbit or tracking move with foreground elements sweeping past the lens.
Alternate take: slow motion, a tighter lens and a gentle rack focus, more intimate performance.
